scope: Original stored TRAIN photos, no synthetic condition. Match the same authored literal requirement and source across all three executed edits. Order rotates. Record full-frame and matching native crops. Admit only direct complete vs concrete failure pairs; keep partial or uncertain observations out of paired supervision. Separate noise/quantization, wrong strength/scope and highlight/colour preservation failures.

instructions.zh: 略微打开人物脸和胡须的暗部，保留背光和树林亮斑的层次。
instructions.en: Slightly lift the shadows on the face and beard, keeping the backlit look and the bright detail in the trees.

instructions.zh: 适度提亮人像暗部，让眼睛和深色头发更清楚，保持自然肤色和柔和背景。
instructions.en: Moderately lift the portrait shadows so the eyes and dark hair read clearly, keeping natural skin tones and the soft background.

instructions.zh: 提亮两个人脸上的暗部，让五官更容易辨认，保留原来的冷暖关系，避免显眼彩色颗粒。
instructions.en: Lift the shadows on both faces until the features are easier to recognize, preserving the existing warm and cool colours without conspicuous colour speckle.

instructions.zh: 小幅提亮合照里的脸和头发暗部，保留肤色和白衣纹理，避免颗粒明显增加。
instructions.en: Slightly lift shadows on the faces and hair, keeping skin tones and the white fabric detail without a conspicuous increase in grain.

instructions.zh: 明显提亮前面两个人的脸，能看清五官，同时保留室内氛围，避免肤色出现明显斑点。
instructions.en: Make the two foreground faces noticeably brighter and easy to recognize, preserving the indoor mood and avoiding obvious speckle on skin.

instructions.zh: 把侧脸和深色衬衫的暗部提亮到更好辨认，保留背景昏暗的气氛，避免彩色斑点。
instructions.en: Lift the shadows so the profile and dark shirt are easier to recognize, preserving the dim background and avoiding coloured blotches.

instructions.zh: 适度打开餐桌周围人物的暗部，让脸更好辨认，同时保留桌灯暖色和夜间气氛。
instructions.en: Moderately lift shadows around the people at the table to make faces easier to recognize while retaining the warm lamps and evening mood.

instructions.zh: 适度提亮两人的暗部，保留衣服纹理、自然肤色和水面天空的层次。
instructions.en: Moderately lift shadows on the couple, keeping clothing detail, natural skin tones and the layers in the water and sky.

instructions.zh: 轻轻提亮海边日出景色的暗部，让前景水纹更容易看见，保留暖色天空和太阳周围的过渡。
instructions.en: Gently lift shadows in this coastal sunrise to reveal more foreground water texture, keeping the warm sky and the gradients around the sun.

instructions.zh: 适度提亮山谷前景的暗部，保留峡谷和天空的暖色层次，不要让粉色天空整体变浅太多。
instructions.en: Moderately lift foreground shadows in the valley, preserving warm layers in the canyon and sky without washing out the pink sky.

instructions.zh: 让夜景山脊和前景细节更清楚，保留星空的深蓝色，避免暗部出现显眼色块。
instructions.en: Reveal more detail in the night ridgeline and foreground while retaining the deep blue starry sky and avoiding obvious blotches in the shadows.

instructions.zh: 略微提亮远处树线和水面倒影中的暗部，保留黄昏轮廓与天空渐变，避免暗处色块。
instructions.en: Gently lift the distant tree line and its reflection, keeping the dusk silhouettes and sky gradient without obvious shadow blotches.

instructions.zh: 提亮星空下的前景，让车和地面纹理更容易看清，同时保留星空和夜景氛围，避免显眼色斑。
instructions.en: Lift the foreground under the stars so the truck and ground texture read more clearly, keeping the star field and night mood without conspicuous colour blotches.

instructions.zh: 略微提亮雪地风景中深色动物的暗部，保留皮毛纹理、原来的蓝天和雪地层次。
instructions.en: Gently lift shadows on the dark animal in the snowy landscape, keeping fur detail, the original blue sky and snow detail.

instructions.zh: 适度提亮观景处前景的暗部，让岩石轮廓更容易看清，保留云层和远山的层次。
instructions.en: Moderately lift the shadows in the overlook foreground so rock contours are easier to read, preserving the layers in the clouds and distant mountains.

instructions.zh: 略微提亮日落前景的暗部，保留人物剪影和太阳周边暖色，避免整片天空变得发白。
instructions.en: Gently lift the sunset foreground while keeping the figures silhouetted and preserving warm colour around the sun without washing out the sky.
